title: Checkout typography — long and multilingual labels
summary: Illustrative typography stress fixture, not repository architecture. Exercises all node kinds, natural word boundaries, qualified identifiers, endpoint paths, grapheme clusters, RTL, explicit line breaks, proposal badges, and bounded truncation. The deliberately long class name represents a generated adapter name.
